title: No database – data lives in JSON files
context: The app is a prototype for exploring the triage workflow; persistence and multi-user editing are out of scope.
decision: Store requests, themes and decisions in /data/*.json and read them at build/request time. Revisit once editing from the UI is needed.

title: Requests are grouped into themes
context: Many incoming requests describe the same underlying need in different words.
decision: Each request points to at most one theme (themeId). A theme owns the requirement document and moves across the board.

title: Next.js App Router with Server Components
context: Pages are read-only views over static data.
decision: Render pages as Server Components; only the navigation is a Client Component (for active-link state).
